note.text: Evidence: Much of Jolly's Neck Farm had been sold off before reaching Elizabeth, but she and Benjamin lived on the remaining portion until Benjamin died in 1810 and Elizabeth followed c. 1815. Jolly's Neck farm
Evidence: . Jolly's Neck farm continued in the Durham family until Elizabeth's grandson, Benjamin Durham II married Sally Ann Hansor, herself a descendant of the original owner.
